newsitem.title: FRANCE: France to sell 30-35 pct of France Telecom - Borotra.
newsitem.headline: France to sell 30-35 pct of France Telecom - Borotra.

text.p: French Industry Minister Franck Borotra said on Friday the market introduction of telecoms operator France Telecom would involve a stake of 30 to 35 percent.
He said the month-long suspension of the operation after early parliamentary elections were called was necessary because of the big public relations campaign needed for the sale.

"It is very simple: France Telecom has one billion shares and of this, we are going to put on the market between 300 and 350 million shares. That needs a big campaign which is incompatible with an election," Borotra told reporters.

Asked whether he would have preferred that President Jacques Chirac wait until after the sale before dissolving parliament, he said a dissolution in July would have been difficult because of the summer holidays.
